Material: CHLORINE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
TOWN EMPLOYEE WAS CALLED OUT TO CHECK A WATER LEAK. WHEN HE RAISED THE GARAGE DOOR TO THE MAINTENANCE SHOP, HE SMELLED A STRONG ODOR OF CHLORINE GAS. HIS BROTHER WAS WITH HIM AND HE CALLED THE TOWN MANAGER WHO IMMEDIATELY CAME TO THE SCENE. A DECISION WAS MADE TO CALL 911. ALSO THE FIRE DEPARTMENT AND RESCUE SQUAD WERE CALLED TO COME TO THE LOCATION. THE EMPLOYEE WAS CHECKED OUT AND TAKEN TO THE LOCAL HOSPITAL AND RELEASED. THE FIRE COMPANY SENT TWO MEN INTO THE BUILDING WHERE THEY DISCOVERED A 150 POUND CYLINDER OF CHLORINE GAS WAS LEAKING. THE HAZMAT TEAM WAS CALLED TO THE LOCATION AND THEY WENT INTO THE BUILDING AND CAPPED OFF THE CHLORINE CYLINDER.

Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS THAT AT LEAST 30,000 GALLONS OF NON-BIO POLYMERS HAS BEEN RELEASED INTO THE ENVIRONMENT, THIS RELEASE CONTAINS POLYETHYLENE, POLYPROPYLENE, NYLON, AND HYDROCHLORIC ACID. CALLER STATES THAT EVERYTHING HAS BEEN SATURATED WITH PH DECREASING SOLVENTS, COSTIC SODA. THE MATERIAL WAS RELEASED BEHIND THE BUILDING INTO A CULVERT AND ONTO THE RAIL ROAD TRACKS THAT ARE NOT OWNED BY THE COMPANY. CALLER STATES THAT THESE MATERIALS WERE RELEASED USING A GAS POWERED PUMP, THIS IS NOT PART OF NORMAL OPERATIONS. THERE WERE MULTIPLE INCIDENTS WITH FLOODING IN THE BUILDING AND IN ORDER TO RESUME OPERATIONS QUICKLY THE GAS POWERED PUMP WAS USED TO AID IN THE REMOVAL PROCESS, SINCE THEY COULD NOT CLEAN UP THE MATERIAL FAST ENOUGH. THEY HAVE AT LEAST 10K POUNDS OF POST CONSUMER PLASTIC (RECYCLED PLASTIC) THAT IS RELEASED OVER A LARGE AREA, 25K-50K SQUARE FEET. THE MATERIAL IS BEING BLOWN OUT OF VENTS THAT DO NOT HAVE SCREENS AND BLOWN EVERYWHERE AND SWEPT OUT THE DOOR BY EMPLOYEES. THE MATERIAL BLOWS EVERYWHERE EVEN ONTO SURROUNDING RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES. CALLER STATE THAT THIS HAS BEEN HAPPENING FOR ABOUT THE LAST 8-9 MONTHS, STARTING IN MAY 2023. THE LAST INCIDENT WAS WITHIN THE LAST 30 DAYS. CALLER HAS IMAGES AND VIDEO UPON REQUEST.

Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT THE LINER OF A POND AT AN EPA CONSTRUCTION SITE (REMEDIATION SITE) WAS PUNCTURED DUE TO UNKNOWN REASONS. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT 1.4 MILLION GALLONS OF WATER CONTAMINATED WITH MERCURY, ANTHRACENE, AND BENZO (A) PYRENE WAS RELEASED INTO THE SOIL BELOW. THE CALLER ALSO STATED THAT THE CONCENTRATION OF ANTHRACENE WAS BETWEEN NON-DETECTABLE AND 0.559 MICRO GRAMS PER LITER OF WATER, AND THE CONCENTRATION OF BENZO (A) PYRENE IS BELIEVED TO BE BETWEEN NON-DETECTABLE AND 0.295 MICRO GRAMS PER LITER OF WATER. THE EXACT AMOUNTS OF THE MATERIAL THAT HAVE CONTAMINATED THE WATER IN THE POND ARE STILL UNKNOWN.
